svg.aria-label: You don't steer AI, you build fences. AI agents start out scattered at design and are funnelled through plan, build, debug and ship into production-grade code. At design and plan, reviewer agents fence the work in; from build onwards, automated checks from the CI template (typecheck, lint, formatting, prose, tests) join them. Work that goes off target is sent back and retried, a failed test goes to debug, which finds the root cause, fixes it and re-runs the tests until they pass, and bkit waits for your sign-off after design, after plan and before merge.

svg.text: Tell an AI what you want and you might get it. Put reviewers and hard checks around it, and anything off target is sent back.
